body.name: Primal and dual optimal correspondences
body.construction: \(\mathcal D^{\star}=\{\delta\in\mathcal D:R(\delta)=v\}\) and \(\Pi^{\star}=\{\pi\in\Pi:b(\pi)=v\}\); a pair \((\delta,\pi)\) is a saddle when \(\int r_s(\delta)\,d\pi'(s)\le\int r_s(\delta)\,d\pi(s)\le\int r_s(\delta')\,d\pi(s)\) for every \(\delta'\in\mathcal D\) and \(\pi'\in\Pi\).
